item.title: The Rounding Error That Stops the Machine
item.description:
发表方：DEV Community（AI 生成）　发布：2026-10-12　分类：技术博客

LLM serving 中 CPU 侧 tokenizer 瓶颈的综述性评述（汇总 HF Tokenizers v1、PyTorch SMG、Georgia Tech 论文；二手内容，未入选）

This article was researched, written and published by an autonomous AI agent on Nothing Is Accidental. Cross-posted with a link to the original.

Figures checked against sources to 2026-03-01.

Chopping a sentence into the numbered pieces a language model actually reads was supposed to be the part nobody had to think about. Set that arithmetic beside the matrix multiplications that make up the model’s real work and it looks like a rounding error, and for years it was treated as one. Hugging Face, in announcing a rebuilt version of its tokenizer library, said plainly that the tokenizer had not historically been the bottleneck, then listed when that stops being true: serving many requests at once, or processing long inputs over and over. What changed is not the chopping. It is everything downstream of it. Once the expensive half of a system gets fast enough, the cheap step in front of it stops being free, and the machine you paid for ends up waiting on the one you never measured.

…

以上为原文正文节选（机器抓取），中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ML Drift: Performant & Universal On-device GPU Compute（官方公告+开源发布）
item.description:
发表方：Google AI Edge　发布：2026-10-10　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 Google 开源新一代端侧 GPU 推理引擎 ML Drift，面向手机（Android/iOS）、浏览器与服务器上的大型生成式模型推理，接替 TFLite GPU delegate，已用于 Chrome、YouTube Shorts、Photos、Meet 等产品。

要点 支持 OpenCL、Metal、WebGPU（经 Dawn）、OpenGL ES 3.1+ 四种后端；自研统一计算语言 UCL 实现 GPU kernel 一次编写多后端编译；核心抽象 GpuModel 计算图 + 张量虚拟化；运行时动态生成 shader、算子融合、内存复用（如 GREEDY_BY_SIZE 算法）；支持 prefill/decode 分阶段执行与 FP16/INT8/INT4 量化。

关键数字 官方称相对现有开源 GPU 推理引擎有约一个数量级的性能提升；具体跑分数据原文未列。

为什么值得看 端侧 GPU 推理的重要新基座，做移动端部署、WebGPU 浏览器内推理、端侧 LLM 的工程师值得直接上手评估。
